entries.analysis: Wyoming only 49 plays/3 yards per play last week, run-heavy slow offense despite air-raid promises; last four totals 34/34/37/28. SJSU short week after Hawaii travel, also slow, both lack pass explosives; strong explosive-pass defenses and red-zone resistance. Projects roughly 20-6.

Memphis revenge after outright upset last year; Stokes/Decker scheme generates explosives, Carter attacks light boxes, Tipton deep threat. UAB pass protection 135th, Burton poor under pressure vs Memphis pass rush; UAB red-zone TD rate dead last. Mike expects 3+ TD margin.

Air Force QB Liam Zarka out for season; backups lack option reps, reducing explosiveness. AF recent point totals inflated by late-game variance, coming off Navy win; NIU off bye with prep and may slow tempo. Expect low-scoring grinder.

Marshall tackling 126th and allows 185 rushing yards; Coastal Deuce Bailey can generate explosives. Marshall gained 444 vs JMU, Del Rio Wilson expected to play and adds QB-run dimension. Rain forecast but little wind at recording; Duck agrees both defenses vulnerable and notes Coastal squandered red-zone scores last week.

entries.analysis: Hawaii devastated by injuries to Ashlock/Harris/Brown, poor OL/rushing and 125th pass explosiveness; bad red-zone execution (7 TDs in 18 trips). Hawaii defensive stats inflated by weak opponents; ASU pass offense should exploit secondary and rebound after Baylor loss. Predicts ASU could score 50. Do not invent exact spread.

UNLV coverage outside top 100, susceptible to intermediate 10–19-yard passes; NDSU QB Nathan Hayes improving and play-action can exploit behind linebackers drawn by strong NDSU run blocking. NDSU pass rush/containment should challenge Jackson Arnold. Predicts NDSU by 10; direct opposition to Stuckey UNLV +3.5.

Tulsa nearly beat strong North Texas, Hayes should improve after injury; Navy 114th pass success defense/127th explosive passes allowed. Tulsa receivers can hit explosives; improved front/tackling can handle Navy option, Navy QB rotation disjointed and rushing output declining. Any plus-money ML acceptable.

NIU QB Terron Dickens improved (548 pass yards, no INT over two games), AF pass rush 124th should ease NIU OL issues. Zarka loss and post-Navy emotional letdown; AF offense lacks proven QB. Combined with Tulsa ML +670 per episode.

Florida strong home offensive output; South Carolina poor second halves, weak SEC run defense, Stewart suspension uncertainty and team turmoil. Florida run game under Buster Faulkner should bounce back against SC; Mike also floats alternative spread ladder +17/+20.5/+27.5/+34.5 as derivatives.
